title: Symvoulio author response
description: What the Author returns for one round (spec 12, steps 1 and 3). The Author returns the whole revised document as Markdown in revised_document and the app writes the revision files; the provider never writes files. One entry in responses per open finding of the previous review. The suggested fields of the spec map as: findings_accepted = responses with response accepted; findings_rejected and evidence_for_rejection = responses with response rejected_with_evidence and their evidence. Strict form: every property is required and no other property is allowed.

evidence.description: Required content for rejected_with_evidence; may be empty otherwise.

new_claims.description: Factual claims this revision adds that were not in the sources.

issue_id.description: Ignored placeholder; the application assigns the question a Q identifier.
